comment: Original DigiTech Space Station Reverse-mode-inspired effect. An onboard Expression value controls reverse-grain length; an LFO modulates that value using Rate and Depth. Not a firmware or algorithm clone.
fxid_comment: 0x01EB. Unused by current effect manifests and tools/effects_db.json at implementation time.

params.name: Expression
params.comment: Base expression position, mapped to reverse-grain length.

params.name: Rate
params.comment: LFO speed for modulating the expression position.

params.name: Depth
params.comment: Amount the LFO sweeps the expression position around its base.

params.name: Mix
params.comment: Blend between live input and the reversed grains.
